name: @lntt/scope
description: The host-agnostic scope runtime for @lntt/wire. ONE primitive — a step wrapping the rest of the fold — and a scope IS the function that runs it. Framework-free: carriers and extensions ship as tree-shakable subpaths and the core names none. The core (#30) and its carriers — ./http, ./trpc, ./react-router (#60) — are built; the extensions and the host mounts land on them next.
